name: Generate Meeting Agenda with Time Allocation
prompt:
Generate a structured meeting agenda and a follow-up email for the following scenario, saving both to files.

Scenario: A 60-minute sprint retrospective for Team Falcon. Date: 2026-04-15, 2:00 PM – 3:00 PM. Attendees: 6 people (product manager, scrum master, 3 engineers, 1 designer). Topics to cover: (1) review what went well, (2) identify what to improve, (3) agree on 3 action items for the next sprint, (4) team shout-outs/recognition. The scrum master facilitates.

Task 1: Save the agenda to agenda.json with this exact structure:
{
  "title": "<meeting title>",
  "date": "2026-04-15",
  "start_time": "14:00",
  "end_time": "15:00",
  "facilitator": "<role>",
  "total_minutes": 60,
  "items": [
    {"order": <1..N>, "topic": "<topic>", "duration_minutes": <number>, "owner": "<role>"}
  ]
}
Requirements: items must cover all 4 topics above, duration_minutes values must sum to exactly 60, each item must have order starting at 1.

Task 2: Save a follow-up email template to followup_email.txt. The email must contain:
- Subject line starting with 'Subject:'
- A greeting line
- A paragraph referencing the retrospective and its date
- A placeholder section labeled 'ACTION ITEMS:' listing at least 3 placeholder action item lines
- A closing line

criteria.description: agenda.json file is present in the working directory.
followup_email.txt file is present in the working directory.
agenda.json contains all required top-level fields: title, date, start_time, end_time, facilitator, total_minutes, and items.
agenda.json total_minutes field is exactly 60 and date/start_time/end_time match the sprint retrospective schedule.
Sum of all item duration_minutes values equals exactly 60.
agenda.json items array has at least 4 entries covering all required retrospective topics.
Each agenda item has numeric order, non-empty topic string, positive duration_minutes, and an owner field.
followup_email.txt contains a line starting with "Subject:".
followup_email.txt contains an "ACTION ITEMS" section label and references the retrospective date 2026-04-15.

eval.rubric:
Context: The agent generated a sprint retrospective agenda and follow-up email template.

Criterion 1: Agenda Practicality (Weight: 60%)
1.0: Time allocations are sensible for a retrospective (e.g., went-well and improve sections get more time than shout-outs), topics are labeled naturally, owners are sensible role assignments, and the agenda would function as a real facilitation guide.
0.5: Agenda is structurally correct but time allocations feel arbitrary or topic labels are too vague.
0: Agenda is missing key topics or has nonsensical time allocations.

Criterion 2: Follow-up Email Tone (Weight: 40%)
1.0: Email is professional, concise, references the specific meeting context (retrospective, Team Falcon), and clearly prompts recipients to review action items. Placeholders are clearly marked and useful.
0.5: Email is functional but generic or misses the retrospective context.
0: Email is missing, too informal, or placeholders are absent.
